items.prompt: Perfectly flat orthographic front view filling the entire frame edge to edge, no perspective, no background, no shadows, even lighting, photographic: a wall-mounted old brown pegboard in a repairman's workshop. The LEFT 40 percent of the board is EMPTY: only bare pegboard holes and a few empty wire hooks, no tools at all. The right 60 percent has old hand tools hanging on hooks: pliers with red handles, wire cutters, a row of spanners, a hammer, a coil of copper wire, a small analog multimeter, a roll of black insulating tape. Worn, dusty, slightly greasy.
